addressed_contract_gap: Predicted-positive occupancy and predeclared constant-detector comparisons on complete recording support.

source_reused_from_existing_cache.role: Verify inherited event merging, splitting, tolerances and rounded denominator; no upstream code redistributed.

prospective_companion_policy.positive_decision: score >= each arm's existing frozen threshold after native finite-float normalization
prospective_companion_policy.time_support: complete score grid; sample i covers [i/fs,(i+1)/fs)
prospective_companion_policy.recording_fraction: positive sample count / n_samples, before event transformations
prospective_companion_policy.patient_fraction: sum positive seconds / sum exact observed seconds over every patient recording
prospective_companion_policy.macro_fraction: equal mean over every selected patient, including undefined-F1 patients
prospective_companion_policy.pooled_fraction: total positive seconds / total exact observed seconds
prospective_companion_policy.constant_controls: Always-negative and always-positive decisions, mandatory in evaluate output, using identical complete selected recordings.
prospective_companion_policy.paired_companion: Descriptive candidate-minus-comparator differences over every selected patient; no new confidence interval or scientific acceptance cutoff.

unchanged_scientific_boundaries: Existing native patient-macro event F1, sensitivity, false-alarm metrics and defined-only F1 support are preserved.
Current task and understanding contracts, histories and v1 implementation are preserved.
No new direct-observation, typed-viewer, tool-assisted or protected frozen-program delivery.
